body.label: Target
body.html: Self; choose an empty visible space within 3 units.

body.label: Effect
body.html: Unopposed. Move up to 2 units toward the chosen space. Learn whether any detected enemy could currently reach that space with normal Movement.

surges.html: One willing ally within 2 units may move 1 unit toward the chosen space.

rider.title: Contingency - Gambit
rider.html: When an enemy finishes moving into the chosen space, make it Exposed and move 1 unit away from it before your next turn.
